title: Framework Artifact Taxonomy
purpose: Defines the normative artifact classes, authority roles, and ownership boundaries for repositories initialized from the framework.

artifact_classes.label: Discovery record
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Captures the problem framing, constraints, and early evidence that justify later planning.

artifact_classes.label: Overview whiteboard
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Durably captures unordered product intent and evidence without interpreting it into requirements, decomposition, specifications, implementation, or accepted functional-set authority.
artifact_classes.mutability: append-oriented and persistent across later lifecycle stages

artifact_classes.label: Overview analysis
artifact_classes.authority_source: analysis of recorded overview whiteboard evidence
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Synthesizes candidate capability groupings, dependencies, ambiguities, and functional-set boundaries without itself establishing approved product direction.

artifact_classes.label: Functional set
artifact_classes.authority_source: explicit user approval of a candidate functional set
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Defines a bounded capability-oriented product-direction unit. Candidate instances are proposals only; an approved instance becomes the directional predecessor authority for its corresponding decomposition without becoming normative product behavior.
artifact_classes.mutability: candidate until approved; approved revisions require governed successor analysis

artifact_classes.label: Product decomposition
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Decomposes directional product intent into bounded areas, dependencies, and unresolved decisions without becoming normative product authority.

artifact_classes.label: Implementation plan
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Coordinates work order, stages, and validation sequencing but cannot redefine accepted overview direction or accepted specifications.

artifact_classes.label: Repository specification
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Defines repository-generic requirements that all initialized repositories inherit.
artifact_classes.mutability: immutable once accepted except through governed revision

artifact_classes.label: Product specification
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Defines product-specific requirements and semantics for a repository derived from the framework, rooted under `product/specs/product/` and governed by the product manifest rather than the repository manifest.
artifact_classes.mutability: immutable once accepted except through governed revision

artifact_classes.label: Schema
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Validates repository-local structure but does not supersede the specification it constrains.
artifact_classes.mutability: immutable once accepted except through governed revision

artifact_classes.label: Manifest or index
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Lists authoritative entries and derived locations without granting authority to the listing itself.
artifact_classes.mutability: mutable only through governed registry updates

artifact_classes.label: Derived projection
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Must be reproducible from declared sources, including repository and product specifications that own the declaration, and must never override the source authority.

artifact_classes.label: Product artifact
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Realizes accepted product specifications but does not define their semantics.

artifact_classes.label: Test artifact
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Evaluates conformance or behavior but does not define product semantics unless an accepted specification assigns that role.

artifact_classes.label: Conformance artifact
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Records whether a product artifact conforms to an accepted specification without becoming the specification itself.

artifact_classes.label: Hosting-platform profile
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Captures provider-specific behavior and configuration without becoming portable framework authority.
artifact_classes.mutability: mutable within the governed profile boundary

artifact_classes.label: Validation evidence
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Documents the exact revision or state that was tested and the outcome observed.

artifact_classes.label: Review record
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Captures reviewer judgment about a proposed revision without itself becoming the accepted revision.

artifact_classes.label: Acceptance record
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Records acceptance of an exact proposed revision without authorizing unrelated successor work.

artifact_classes.label: Release record
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Records publication of an accepted revision and does not redefine the underlying specification.

artifact_classes.label: Hosting profile source
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Defines reusable hosting-platform profile source material under `repo/profiles/`; when populated for a supported profile, it may project installed adapters without granting those adapters independent authority.

artifact_classes.label: Installed hosting adapter
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Mirrors a hosting profile into installed repository-local adapters such as `.github/` files; installed adapters are generated from profile source material and remain subordinate to that source rather than becoming normative authority themselves.

artifact_classes.label: Hosting deployment state
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Records remote branch protection, rulesets, required checks, merge queues, labels, and repository settings using explicit desired-state, inspection, apply, rollback, and verification records without becoming repository content.

artifact_classes.label: Bootstrap hosting infrastructure
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Supports current hosting-platform checks and policy behavior without becoming universal framework authority.

artifact_classes.label: User convenience
artifact_classes.source_of_truth_rule: Supports user-facing convenience or session continuity only; accepted repository and product authority remain controlling, and this class shall not establish or override repository, product, workflow, planning, validation, or implementation semantics.
artifact_classes.mutability: mutable as user-facing convenience material under governed repository boundaries

normative_requirements.text: The repository shall define exactly one canonical artifact taxonomy for framework-generic and repository-local artifact classes.

The taxonomy shall distinguish directional, planning, normative, generated, implementation, evidentiary, review, acceptance, release, profile-specific, and convenience authority categories, and shall distinguish overview collection evidence, overview analysis synthesis, candidate functional sets, and approved functional sets.

The taxonomy shall state for each recognized class its role, authority category, authority source, source-of-truth rule, mutability, generation mode, validation ownership, portability category, and manifest participation.
An artifact's authority_category shall name the artifact class's authority role, while lifecycle status and governing text determine whether that role is effective for a specific document instance.

An overview whiteboard, overview analysis, functional set, plan, generated artifact, implementation artifact, validation evidence record, review record, acceptance record, or release record shall not claim normative product-specification authority.
Generated artifacts shall remain subordinate to declared source artifacts and shall not become semantic sources merely because they are materialized.
Framework-generic, product-specific, and profile-specific classes shall be distinguished, and profile-specific classes shall not be treated as universal framework authority.
Merge shall remain a revision event rather than an artifact class, and merge evidence shall not substitute for acceptance or release.

The taxonomy shall distinguish hosting-profile source artifacts, installed adapters, bootstrap infrastructure, and remote deployment-state evidence so repository-local profile mechanics remain separate from Git-generic authority.
Installed adapters shall remain subordinate to the profile source and shall not become semantic sources merely because they are materialized under `.github/`.

The taxonomy shall classify user-facing convenience and session-support artifacts as non-normative user convenience material subordinate to accepted repository and product authority; such artifacts shall not establish or override repository, product, workflow, planning, validation, or implementation semantics.

The overview-whiteboard class shall remain evidentiary, the overview-analysis class shall remain directional synthesis, and a functional-set artifact shall distinguish candidate from approved lifecycle status; only an approved functional set may act as the directional predecessor authority for decomposition.
